title: RC Candidate Verdict v1
description: Subagent C's verdict on release-candidate eligibility, produced by running the release gate validator against readiness gate, blockers, validation runs, deferred risks, and evidence paths.

verdict.description: go = candidate is eligible for RC promotion; hold = not eligible.

generated_at.description: ISO 8601 timestamp when the verdict was generated.

branch.description: Git branch at time of verdict.

head_sha.description: Git HEAD SHA at time of verdict.

gate_artifact.description: Path to the readiness gate artifact that was validated.

validator_result.description: Whether the validator produced a clean pass.

validator_error_count.description: Number of errors reported by the validator.

blocking_phase_ids.description: Phase IDs that are blocking release (status blocked, unknown, or failed validation).

ready_phase_ids.description: Phase IDs that are passing or ready.

open_blocker_ids.description: Blocker IDs that are still open.

resolved_blocker_ids.description: Blocker IDs that have been resolved.

deferred_risk_ids.description: Deferred risk IDs tracked for this release candidate.

validation_run_ids.description: Validation run IDs referenced by the gate.

evidence_paths.description: Evidence paths collected across all phases.

required_next_actions.description: Human-readable next actions required to advance gate status from hold to go.

error_categories.description: Breakdown of validator errors by category.

missing_evidence_paths.description: Count of missing evidence path errors.

missing_blockers.description: Count of missing blocker reference errors.

missing_validation_runs.description: Count of missing validation run reference errors.

missing_test_classifications.description: Count of missing test classification errors.

missing_schema_validation.description: Count of missing schema validation result errors.

forbidden_markdown_evidence.description: Count of forbidden Markdown evidence errors.

malformed_jsonl.description: Count of malformed JSONL parse errors.
